title: Reading Drill — Testing a shallow pond ramp — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing a shallow pond ramp — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Hillswick began with reports of animals reaching the edge but being unable to leave the water. The wildlife centre staff had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using daytime observations and chose successful exits as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was a rougher ramp surface. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted eight weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded fluctuating water height as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
